name: OSINT War Room
description: Fork of Hue-Jhan/OSINT-War-Room: a FastAPI backend (backend/main.py, port 8000) that serves a vanilla-JS Leaflet tactical dashboard and four routers (/api/radar, /api/alerts, /api/economy, /api/news) proxying GDELT conflict events, Ukraine air-raid alarms, OpenStreetMap military bases, OpenSky aircraft, AISStream vessels, CISA KEV vulnerabilities, Telegram frontline channels, yfinance markets, Polymarket odds and the Pentagon Pizza Index into one command-center view with a nuke simulator and DEFCON meter. State is a flat backend/database.json holding scraped alerts and the channel list; everything else is in-memory cache. In the Notations Universe it is a lightweight rendering dock and a catalogue of conflict-domain feeds; it must not become a canonical record and its person-facing scraping (Telegram, disabled Twitter) should stay confined to public channel previews.

capabilities.label: Backend status
capabilities.description: GET /api/status returns a static liveness string for the FastAPI backend.

capabilities.label: Tactical dashboard
capabilities.description: Principal view served from /: a Leaflet tactical map with region presets (Global, Middle East, Ukraine, Taiwan), Split.js multi-pane layout, floating panels, DEFCON threat meter, casualty tracker, procedural sound engine and a customizable webcam grid of YouTube/CCTV streams.

capabilities.label: GDELT conflict events
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar/conflicts downloads the latest GDELT 2.0 events export, filters explosion/attack event codes prioritising the Middle East and Ukraine, and returns geocoded events with NumKilled/NumWounded; cached 15 min with pending-request locking.

capabilities.label: Ukraine air raid alarms
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar/alarms polls api.alerts.in.ua for active air raid alerts; also feeds the DEFCON threat meter.

capabilities.label: Military bases (OSM)
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar/bases queries the Overpass API for military bases, airfields and naval ports across Ukraine, the Middle East and the Taiwan Strait; cached 6 h.

capabilities.label: Live aircraft (OpenSky)
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar/aircraft?lamin&lomin&lamax&lomax returns OpenSky state vectors (position, altitude, heading, callsign) for a bounding box.

capabilities.label: AIS vessels
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar/ships opens a short AISStream websocket subscription over four regional bounding boxes and returns collected vessel positions colour-coded by type; the API key is hardcoded as a placeholder in radar.py and the working AIS feed is opened client-side in frontend/js/map.js.

capabilities.label: CISA KEV cyber feed
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar/cyber returns recent CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities mapped to world coordinates and typed (exploit, DDoS, malware, breach).

capabilities.label: Ground radar placeholder
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar/ground returns an empty dataset; reserved for a future ground-track layer.

capabilities.label: Telegram frontline alerts
capabilities.description: GET /api/alerts/telegram returns the last 200 posts scraped every 15 s from public t.me/s/<channel> previews by the background task started in main.py and cached in backend/database.json.

capabilities.label: Read Telegram channel settings
capabilities.description: GET /api/alerts/settings returns the configured channel list (defaults: monitor_the_situation, terroralarm, ConflictsTracker, aljazeeraglobal, OSINTWarfare).

capabilities.label: Update Telegram channel settings
capabilities.description: POST /api/alerts/settings {channels[]} rewrites settings.telegram_channels in backend/database.json and redirects the scraper. Writes persistent configuration.

capabilities.label: Unified news feed
capabilities.description: GET /api/news/feed merges cached alerts and news from database.json sorted by timestamp (max 200). The Twitter scraper behind it is disabled; the route is marked unused in the README.

capabilities.label: Market dashboard
capabilities.description: GET /api/economy/markets returns yfinance quotes and daily change for S&P 500, FTSE 100, Nikkei, gold, silver, WTI, natural gas, wheat, BTC, ETH, XMR; GET /api/economy/vix returns the VIX fear index.

capabilities.label: Polymarket geopolitical odds
capabilities.description: GET /api/economy/polymarket returns live prediction-market odds from gamma-api.polymarket.com with sports filtered out, showing 24h trending and highest-volume markets.

capabilities.label: Pentagon Pizza Index
capabilities.description: GET /api/economy/pizza proxies monitor-the-situation.com/api/pizza (order volume near the Pentagon as an activity proxy) into a doughcon level and graph.

capabilities.label: News ticker headlines
capabilities.description: GET /api/economy/ticker aggregates RSS headlines from BBC World, Reuters, Al Jazeera and AP for the scrolling ticker.

capabilities.label: Nuclear detonation simulator
capabilities.description: Click-to-detonate simulation in the map UI using Glasstone & Dolan cube-root scaling for seven historical weapons and five blast rings; a modelled overlay, not a live layer.

capabilities.label: Tactical tools
capabilities.description: Distance measurement, custom labelled markers, coordinate HUD, legend, simulated radio-intercept widget (Web Audio) and DEFCON meter derived from active alarms plus GDELT event density.

metadata.person_data_note: Telegram channel previews and conflict reporting carry names; nothing is indexed by person.

location.label: Kyiv (Ukraine air-raid alarm focus and default region preset)

resources.name: Flat-file cache
resources.description: Scraped Telegram alerts (max 200) and user channel settings.

external_services.name: AISStream.io
external_services.auth: API key hardcoded in frontend/js/map.js and placeholder in radar.py

external_services.name: ACLED
external_services.purpose: conflict data (OAuth token helper present, placeholder credentials)

external_services.name: BBC / Reuters / Al Jazeera / AP RSS

reference.spatial: Regional tactical map with presets for Global, Middle East, Ukraine and Taiwan; all feeds are point-geocoded.
reference.temporal: Near-real-time: Telegram every 15 s, GDELT every 15 min, bases every 6 h; no history beyond the last 200 alerts.
open_questions: No environment variables are read: the AIS key is hardcoded client-side and ACLED credentials are placeholders in radar.py; secrets handling must be introduced before any shared deployment.
requirements.txt pins scraping and captcha-solving libraries (2captcha, apify, tweety, cloudscraper) that no served route uses; confirm intended scope.
Last upstream push is June 2026 and no Notations-specific commits are visible; treat as a pure upstream mirror.

corpus.holding: Almost nothing: a flat backend/database.json holding the last 200 scraped alerts and a channel list; everything else is in-memory cache.

COR-008.note: backend/database.json is a mutable flat file holding the last 200 alerts, so what it showed yesterday is gone without trace.

COR-009.note: Routers proxy upstream feeds into a view; nothing is written back to any source.

COR-010.note: It must not become a canonical record and its person-facing scraping should stay confined to public channel previews, but the Telegram scraping path is unbounded and an AIS key is hardcoded.
